_source: .claude/work/2026-09-21-step3-tickets/QUESTION-SET.md (outside git). Read that for the per-question 'Accept when' column and the SHOULD CHANGE / SHOULD HOLD / STILL OPEN marks.
_criteria_note: Deliberately loose on wording, strict on numbers. Route where the engine is known, and last_reply nonempty everywhere, so a budget-capped or errored turn cannot score green. The real acceptance is still the 'Accept when' column and is read by a human: most of these are judgements about wording ('never an invented pagination story') that no regex should settle. BUT a case whose truth is a NUMBER now asserts that number, because route-plus-nonempty let two confidently wrong answers score green in the 2026-09-21 run: q10 and q11 both answered 0 against a measured 737. Numbers pinned here and where they come from: 745 = T_MUS carrying a Genotype matching ^CC[0-9], counted live on 2026-09-22 (it was 737 on 2026-09-21); 482 and 13-or-20 = the two step3_mixed cases' measured Pilot A truths. The CC number is the one to re-measure before trusting a red on it, and there is now a trap beside it: the operator's 2026-09-22 metadata write tagged 209 of those 745 with the phrase 'collaborative cross', all of them inside the 745, and it covers none of CC042, which alone is 427 samples. So a reply of 209 means the answer came from the tag rather than from the Genotype attribute, which is the failure this case tests for, and it is harder to spot than the 0 it used to answer.
_cost_note: ~45 turns. One (step3.cc_big_csv_turn_limit) is deliberately a Container-CC request big enough to hit the 180 s cap: that is the point of it, and CC turns are the expensive ones.
_not_included: mixed.flow_from_rhesus_lymph_node and mixed.ivbcg_nhp_with_sequencing are NOT in nessie_tests/corpus.json -- they are Pilot A mixed-r4 cases. They are written inline here from PilotAPOC/cases/mixed-r4.json with their measured truths.
